newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Filinvest to buy land through share swaps.
newsitem.headline: Filinvest to buy land through share swaps.

text.p: Filinvest Land Inc (FLI) said on Monday its board of directors had approved a deal under which land owned by Filinvest Development Corp (FDC) and Filinvest Alabang Inc (FAI) would be exchanged for unissued FLI shares.

Corporate secretary Dante Ramos told the Philippine Stock Exchange the parent firm FDC would exchange several parcels of land in the Manila suburb of Las Pinas, and FAI would sell several of its lots in neighbouring Alabang for an as yet undetermined number of shares.
"The value for each FLI share shall be determined on the basis of its closing price at the Philippine Stock Exchange as of the date of the deed," Ramos said.
